summary: Buying an additional home adds 5 percentage points to every stamp duty band.
Section 21 'no-fault' evictions ended on 1 May 2026; existing assured shorthold tenancies became periodic assured tenancies.

All privately rented homes must reach EPC C (new metrics) by 1 October 2030, with a £10,000 spending cap per property (10% of value if worth under £100,000). Homes rated C before 1 October 2029 count as compliant until that EPC expires.
Individual landlords can't deduct mortgage interest; they get a 20% tax credit on it instead. Companies deduct interest as a cost.
Property income tax rates rise to 22% / 42% / 47%, and the interest credit is proposed to rise to 22%.
Hexthorpe has a selective licensing scheme (operational from 1 March 2022, for up to 5 years): landlords there need a licence. Edlington's scheme ended in February 2023.
Universal Credit housing support in Doncaster is capped at £425 (1 bed), £500 (2 bed), £550 (3 bed) and £725 (4 bed) a month in 2026-27.
